mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_message (session_id, role, content, cited_chunk_ids, retrieval_meta) VALUES (#{sessionId}, #{role}, #{content}, #{citedChunkIds}, #{retrievalMeta})
mapper.select: SELECT id, session_id, role, content, cited_chunk_ids, retrieval_meta, created_at FROM chat_message WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} ORDER BY created_at ASC, id ASC
